CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.calender
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://awstoragedatalakeh.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) as QUER1
